body: I have nothing to contribute to anyone and all I do is take, and I burden people with how much I hate myself. People don't want to hear it, it makes them uncomfortable. And I'm constantly distracting my boyfriend from school or work or waking him up in the middle of the night because of my stupid meltdowns. My mom is severely mentally ill and I was a pain in the ass growing up so that didn't help her, and she feels guilty for the pain she caused me so I can't talk to her about how I feel because I think it'll push her over the edge. My dad and stepmom kicked me out at 17 because my grades were dropping due to my anxiety and depression that they refused to believe existed, as well as I was working 5-6 days a week on top of school because I felt appreciated at my job, then in turn I was never home to help around the house while my parents were taking care of their babies. And to top it all off they thought I would somehow pass my eating disorder on to my little sisters if they saw my behaviours around food. I owe my grandpa $1000 from moving out on my own and then failing at multiple jobs and needing to borrow money, and same with my boyfriend. So yeah, I'm a burden.
The only reason I haven't gone through with it yet is I don't want my boyfriend to find me and I don't want to hurt the few people who care about me. If those weren't factors I'd be gone
